subject: English
question: Which conclusion is best supported by both sources?
options: The creek track is always closed after rain
A visitor arriving at 4:20 pm can safely start the full loop
The lookout can be reached without using the creek track
The visitor centre closes before the final shuttle arrives
explanation: Source 1 shows the lookout is accessible from the ridge path, while Source 2 only closes the creek track after 4 pm. Together they show the lookout still has an open route.
stimulus:
SOURCE 1 — Park map note
Visitor Centre → Ridge Path → Lookout
Visitor Centre → Creek Track → Lookout

SOURCE 2 — Ranger notice
After 4 pm today, Creek Track is closed because of rising water. Ridge Path remains open until sunset.

subject: English
question: Why is the final sentence especially effective?
options: It repeats every detail from the paragraph
It shifts from description to a quiet warning, changing how the reader interprets the scene
It proves the storm has already ended
It tells the reader exactly how many birds are present
explanation: Most of the passage is calm description. The final sentence introduces approaching thunder, so its contrast changes the mood and foreshadows a coming storm.
stimulus: The bay lay flat and silver beneath a pale sky. Pelicans rested on the posts, and the mangroves hardly moved. Far beyond the headland, however, a low roll of thunder answered the quiet.

subject: English
question: In this passage, what does “counterproductive” most nearly mean?
options: Producing the opposite of the intended result
Working more quickly than expected
Requiring two people to complete
Preventing any result from being measured
explanation: The team wanted to save time, but skipping the equipment check caused a delay. The context therefore shows that the action produced the opposite of its intended result.
stimulus: To save time, the team skipped the equipment check before leaving. Halfway to the site they discovered a missing cable and had to return. Their shortcut had been counterproductive.

subject: Mathematics
question: A craft kit needs 3 blue beads for every 2 yellow beads. Mia uses 18 blue beads and keeps the same ratio. She then adds 4 extra yellow beads. How many yellow beads are there altogether?
explanation: 18 blue beads is 6 groups of 3, so the matching yellow amount is 6 × 2 = 12. Adding 4 extra yellow beads gives 16.

subject: Mathematics
question: Ava must spend at least 20 minutes at the exhibition and then catch a bus. Which bus is the earliest she can catch if she enters the exhibition at 2:47 pm and the bus stop is a 6-minute walk away?
explanation: Twenty minutes from 2:47 is 3:07. Adding the 6-minute walk gives 3:13, so the earliest listed bus she can catch is 3:15 pm.

subject: Mathematics
question: A shape is made from five equal squares as shown. Each square has side length 2 cm. What is the perimeter of the whole shape?
options: 20 cm
24 cm
28 cm
40 cm
explanation: Five separate squares have 20 unit edges altogether. The shape has five shared edges, and each shared edge removes two outside edges, leaving 10 unit edges. At 2 cm each, the perimeter is 20 cm.

subject: Science
question: Which conclusion is justified by the results?
options: Foil always keeps every liquid hottest
Wool was the best insulator of the three materials in this test
No wrap caused the cup to gain heat
Bubble wrap cannot be used as insulation
explanation: All cups started at the same temperature and were measured after the same time. Wool had the highest final temperature, so it reduced heat loss most effectively in this test only.
stimulus:
All cups started at 70°C. After 20 minutes:
No wrap 42°C
Foil 49°C
Bubble wrap 54°C
Wool 58°C

subject: Science
question: If insect numbers fall sharply for several weeks, which change is most directly supported by this food web?
options: Frogs may have less food available
Grass will stop using sunlight
Hawks will immediately become herbivores
Snakes will produce more insects
explanation: The arrows show insects are a food source for frogs. A sustained fall in insects therefore directly reduces one of the frogs’ available food sources; the other changes are not supported by the web.
stimulus:
Grass → Insects → Frogs → Snakes
Seeds → Mice → Snakes
Frogs → Hawks
Mice → Hawks

subject: Science
question: Which explanation best fits all three observations?
options: A cooler air mass arrived, bringing cloud and rain
The Sun moved farther away from Earth during the afternoon
The thermometer stopped working because wind increased
Rain always makes wind blow from the same direction
explanation: A rapid temperature drop together with rising cloud cover and rain is consistent with a cooler air mass or weather front moving through. The other options do not explain all observations.
stimulus:
12:00 — 27°C, light cloud, dry
2:00 — 23°C, cloud increasing, windy
4:00 — 18°C, overcast, rain beginning
